steps.content: Sound Effect: [Thunder] [Rain]
[Flash of Lightning] [Sea Surface]
A thunderclap jolts you back to consciousness.
You draw a ragged breath and are met with the burn of saltwater. It floods your ears, your mouth, your mind—until the storm's roar is all that remains.

You thrash, legs scrambling for a purchase that isn't there. Your entire world has shrunk to the sodden piece of driftwood you cling to. With every surge, the waves try to claim it, and you along with it.
Blegh...

But this is no ordinary seawater. It's a liquid contamination known as the <color=#fb9259>Black Tide</color>. In the depths, Mania creatures brush against your legs. You feel the sharp sting as they latch on, peeling back skin to siphon your life away.

The downpour fuels the contamination, whipping the waves into a frenzy beneath the lightning's glare. The cold has long since numbed your limbs; the hammering rain is just a dull percussion on deadened skin.

Darkness stretches to every horizon.
This is your third hour drifting alone in the abyss.

[Thunder] [Lightning] [Small CG Back Silhouette]
High above in the dilapidated lantern room, the lighthouse keeper leans against the great lens, wiping monster fluid from her hands onto her coat before gripping the beacon's control lever.

steps.speaker: Lighthouse Keeper
steps.content: The 2,019th time...

steps.speaker: Lighthouse Keeper
steps.content: The 2,019th time I've climbed up here alone.
With a grunt, she throws her full weight against the control lever, forcing the beacon to turn toward the distant seam between sea and sky.
The aged motor groans, its rumble merging with the wind and thunder, a cacophony lost in the distant darkness.

steps.speaker: Lighthouse Keeper
steps.content: Take me away, you old things... Just end it all.
She grits her teeth, twists the handle, and the light erupts in the rhythmic pattern she programmed long ago, a flashing message sent into the void.
And like the 2,018 nights before, she stares expressionlessly toward the horizon that never responds. Until...
The beam cuts through the black chaos, casting a faint spot of light.
And in its path, a dark speck bucks against the waves.

steps.speaker: Lighthouse Keeper
steps.content: A mutated Tide Crawler? No... that's not it.
Carried closer by the tide, the speck grows into a distinct <color=#fb9259>figure</color>. A person. Clinging to driftwood, one arm waving a frantic signal against the storm.

steps.speaker: Lighthouse Keeper
steps.content: A living person?!
[Thunder] [Flash of Lightning] [Sea Surface]
A lighthouse!
Cough... Is anyone there?! Hel—

Hours of struggle have left your strength spent, your throat ragged from saltwater. Even the last air in your lungs is useless, your cries swallowed by the thunder of the waves. But you refuse to give up.

You are a plaything for the sea, hurled skyward only to be slammed down again, your insides churning with every impact. The contaminated water seeps deeper into your wounds, a corrosive fire, yet you kick on, driven by the sight of a distant light.
It doesn't look too far... The wind... I can go with the flow, ride the rising tide... cough, cough, cough!
You choke, nostrils flooding with putrid brine. By the time you gasp clear and look up—the light is gone.
HEEEY! Is anyone there...?
Darkness reclaims you. Your feeble call for help vanishes into the vast, indifferent ocean.
Even so, one thought burns through the despair: You still don't know Hella's situation. You can't die here. You absolutely cannot!
I remember the direction of the light. No landmarks, but I can use the wind and waves to orient myself. My bearings can't be too far off. I can...
Your waterlogged limbs, heavy and numb, respond with a clumsy, desperate paddle.

You've lost count of how much black water you've vomited, your world narrowed to the sight of that vanished light seared into your mind. Then, a new sound. The crash of waves against rock. Your strokes become frantic.
Finally, impact. Your knees strike stone, then your palms scrape hard ground as you haul your broken body onto the shore.
[Light Switch Sound Effect] [White Flash]

Solid earth. The relief is instantaneous, dissolving your last shred of tension, and exhaustion crashes over you like a final wave. Consciousness flickers; you dream of the sun burning your back. The crunch of footsteps on sand approaches, halting before you.
Rescue... finally?
You force your head up to face the blinding glare. This is no dream. The sun is a lighthouse, and what greets you is not salvation—
But murderous intent. A boot grinds down on your hand, stopping you cold.
[Small CG: Silhouette]

steps.speaker: Lighthouse Keeper
steps.content: Identify yourself. Name. Any tricks...

steps.speaker: Lighthouse Keeper
steps.content: You'll be dead.
